sophia_cs: Heads-up — FinPay reached out this morning saying their assistant "is answering like it's in a hurry" after last night's model bump. They gave side-by-side examples and flagged a request id: 8a7f2c. They're on Dedicated. Can eng/ML help repro?

raj_engineer: Thanks — can you paste the before/after examples here? Also which model tag/version was rolled?

sophia_cs: Paste below (customer redacted names). They said the old variant was kepler-v9 and we rolled kepler-v10 at ~03:12 UTC.
```
User: "How do I refund a failed transaction?"
Before (kepler-v9):
"You can refund a failed transaction from Payments > Transactions. Click the transaction, choose 'Refund', confirm amount. If you need, I can walk you through the exact steps or generate the refund API call."
After (kepler-v10):
"Go to Payments > Transactions and refund it."
```

emily_support: I ran a quick curl against the customer's workspace token with the same prompt and got a similarly terse reply. Curl we used: 
```bash
curl -sS -X POST 
  https://api.redwood.com/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' 
  -d '{"model":"kepler-v10","input":"How do I refund a failed transaction?"}'
```
Response length token-wise fell from ~58 tokens (v9) to ~29 tokens (v10) in our logs for this prompt.

deploy-bot: deploy-log: rollout kepler-v10 to hosted/dedicated pools completed 2026-03-15T03:12:07Z by release/infra-214.

devon_ml: Possible quick checks: did we change any default assistant/system prompt or temperature/top_p across variants? Also new quantization/kernel changes can alter tokenization or early-eos behavior. Two hypotheses: (1) truncated continuation due to different stop tokens or EOS index changed in tokenizer, (2) update to default system message that tightened response brevity (we shipped a compressed system prompt to save tokens).

raj_engineer: Where are the request logs? I want the exact request/response for 8a7f2c. If dedicated, we should get the per-token trace from that instance.

emily_support: Attached the trimmed log snippet from their dedicated node (redacted):
```
request_id=8a7f2c, model=kepler-v10, input_tokens=12, output_tokens=29, latency=210ms
response_text="Go to Payments > Transactions and refund it."
stack: runtime-serve-03 -> infer-02 -> quant-kern-5
```

devon_ml: That quant-kern-5 hint is important — quant kernel change was part of v10 rollout for cheaper memory. We'll re-run that prompt against kepler-v10 with full float kernels to see if behavior matches kepler-v9. Also will run with explicit system prompt from v9 to isolate system-message drift.

sophia_cs: Customer is asking for a rollback window if we can't show a fix/ETA within 24 hours. They said the terse replies are impacting CS bounce rates.

raj_engineer: I'll spin up a small repro matrix: (a) kepler-v9 baseline, (b) kepler-v10 quant-kern-5, (c) kepler-v10 float-kernel, (d) kepler-v10 + v9 system prompt. Will report token counts + cosine similarity on embeddings for the outputs.

devon_ml: Also request that support grab 8-10 representative prompts from FinPay (they already provided 4). We'll put them through the diff pipeline: token traces, logits check for early-EOS, and a short eval that flags omissions (e.g., missing step-by-step instructions). If we confirm it's model-side, recommend a canary rollback for Dedicated pools and block further kepler-v10 rollouts to similar customers.

emily_support: Created ticket SUP-2026-309 with the examples + logs and linked the rollback request. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/SUP-2026-309 :thumbsup:

sophia_cs: Thanks — please @raj_engineer and @devon_ml when you have the repro results. Customer expects a status update in 6 hours.

raj_engineer: Will update in ~3 hours with initial diffs. If we see quant kernel as root cause, we'll coordinate with runtime to hotfix kernel or temporarily pin dedicated pools to float kernel for affected tenants.

devon_ml: Quick note — also check whether caching/prefix behavior changed. If we introduced more aggressive prefix stripping for assistant prompts, that could shorten outputs. I'll add that to the matrix.

emily_support: Acknowledge. Temp owner: emily_support.

sophia_cs: Adding for visibility: @product (cc: @platform) — FinPay is enterprise tier, they may escalate if not resolved quickly.

raj_engineer: (reacts :thinking: )

devon_ml: I'll post reproducible run logs here once done. If anyone else has similar customer reports, please paste them in this thread so we can see scope.

sophia_cs: copying customer on expected timeline and will hold rollback ask pending your repro.

emily_support: End state: collect 10 prompts, run matrix, attach diffs to SUP-2026-309, decide rollback (if needed) within 24h.

sophia_cs: TY all.
